product.title: Highlights of London Private Tour with Notting Hill

description.text: In London, Start at SoHo, Chinatown, and Westminster before taking the tube to the lively Notting Hill neighborhood. Stroll through Portobello Road Market, savor a classic English tea and pastry, and see filming locations from the Hugh Grant and Julia Roberts movie, Notting Hill. Stops include Soho, Chinatown, Westminster, Notting Hill, Portobello Road Market. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on royal landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
